features.title: Platform imwe. Imikorere yose.
features.subtitle: Cungira ubucuruzi bwawe bwose bwo kwakira abakiriya muri Platform imwe ifite ubwenge — komande, ububiko, ubwishyu, ubushishozi n'iterambere.
features.qr_ordering_desc: Abakiriya basikana QR Code, bakareba Menu kandi bagatanga komande bakoresheje telefoni zabo — nta App ikenewe.
features.inventory_desc: Kurikirana ububiko, shyiraho igihe cyo kongera gutumiza kandi ucunge Purchase Orders hamwe n'amateka yuzuye.
features.reports_desc: Raporo za buri munsi, buri cyumweru na buri kwezi. Menya inyungu, ibyakoreshejwe n'umusaruro mu kanya gato.
features.ai_insights_desc: Inama z'ubwenge zo kongera gutumiza n'alerts ku biciro bidasanzwe kugira ngo urinde inyungu zawe.
features.discovery_feed_desc: Sangiza abakiriya inyandiko, Promotions n'amafoto. Bafashe kukubona no gutanga komande bahereye kuri Feed yawe.
features.smart_slips_desc: Inyemezabwishyu za Digital zikozwe mu buryo bwikora, zigaragaza ibisobanuro byose hamwe n'ibihembo byo kohereza abandi kuri WhatsApp.
features.loyalty_desc: Kubaka ubudahemuka bw'abakiriya ukoresheje amanota, ibyiciro n'igenzura ry'ibihembo.
features.promotions_desc: Shyiraho Promotions z'igihe runaka n'amapaki yihariye atangira kandi akarangira mu buryo bwikora.
features.whatsapp_desc: Akira Alerts za komande, incamake za buri munsi n'amenyesha y'ububiko buke kuri WhatsApp.
features.mobile_money_desc: Akira ubwishyu bwa Mobile Money ako kanya — nta POS Terminal ikenewe.
features.multi_branch_desc: Cunga amashami menshi muri Dashboard imwe hamwe na raporo rusange cyangwa iz'ishami rimwe.
features.roles_desc: Ushinzwe kashi, umuseriveri, umugenzuzi n'umucungamutungo — buri wese abona ibyo yemerewe gusa.

advanced.title: Yubakiwe Iterambere
advanced.subtitle: Ibyo ukeneye byose kugira ngo ukure uva ku ishami rimwe ujye ku bucuruzi bugezweho bwo kwakira abakiriya — byose muri Platform imwe ifite ubwenge.
advanced.hotel_mode_desc: Cunga ibyumba, serivisi n'ibikorwa byose bya hoteli muri Platform imwe.
advanced.site_builder_desc: Kora Website yawe ukoresheje Templates ushobora guhindura uko ushaka — nta bumenyi bwa coding bukenewe.
advanced.ai_menu_desc: Hindura Menu yawe ibe iya Digital mu minota mike. Ohereza ifoto cyangwa PDF, AI ihite ikora Menu y'umwuga yiteguye gutumizwaho.
advanced.marketplace_desc: Fasha abakiriya benshi kuvumbura ubucuruzi bwawe binyuze muri ecosystem ya Imboni, hamwe na profile zishakishwa, Promotions n'ukugaragara kuri Digital.
advanced.procurement_desc: Cunga ibyo ugura, abatanga ibikoresho, ububiko n'igiciro cy'ibiribwa mu buryo bugaragara neza kuva ku kwakira ibicuruzwa kugeza ku mikoreshereze.
advanced.referral_desc: Sangiza abandi, winjize — abakiriya batumira inshuti zabo bagahita babona ibihembo mu buryo bwikora.
advanced.staff_desc: Genzura uburenganzira bwa buri mukozi ukoresheje inshingano n'uruhushya rworoshye kubicunga.
advanced.multi_branch_desc: Cunga amashami menshi ukoresheje Platform imwe, raporo zihuriweho, ukugaragara kw'ububiko n'imikorere ihamye.
advanced.business_intelligence_desc: Kurikirana igurisha, imyitwarire y'abakiriya, ububiko n'imari ukoresheje Insights z'igihe nyacyo zigufasha gufata ibyemezo byiza.

payments.title: Emera uburyo bwo kwishyura abakiriya bawe bakoresha
payments.subtitle: Hitamo uburyo bwo kwishyura bujyanye n'isoko ryawe — Mobile Money, amakarita, Cash na Digital Wallets.

final_cta.title: Witeguye guhindura imikorere y'ubucuruzi bwawe?

footer.copyright: Imboni Serve. Yubakiwe ubucuruzi bwo kwakira abakiriya.

how_it_works.title: Uko Bikorwa
how_it_works.subtitle: Intambwe 6 zoroshye zo kujyana ubucuruzi bwawe kuri Digital no gutangira gutanga serivisi mu buryo buhanitse.
how_it_works.step1_desc: Iyandikishe mu minota 2. Uzuza izina ry'ubucuruzi bwawe, aho ukorera n'amakuru ya nyir'ubucuruzi, maze uhite ubona Dashboard yawe.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Ongeraho ibiryo n'ibinyobwa hamwe n'amafoto, ibiciro n'ibisobanuro. Cyangwa ukoreshe AI Menu Builder ushyireho ifoto cyangwa PDF, AI ihite ikora Menu yawe.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Shyiraho ameza yawe (Table 1, VIP Section, Terrace n'ibindi) hanyuma ukore QR Code yihariye kuri buri meza muri Dashboard yawe. Zicapishe uzishyire ku meza.
how_it_works.step4_desc: Huza nimero yawe ya WhatsApp kugira ngo ubone komande ako kanya na raporo za buri munsi. Hitamo uburyo bwo kwishyura bukworoheye.
how_it_works.step5_desc: Ongeraho ibicuruzwa byo mu bubiko, shyiraho aho wongera kubitumiza kandi ukurikirane ibyo ugura byose. AI izakumenyesha igihe ibiciro byazamutse cyangwa ububiko bugiye gushira.
how_it_works.step6_desc: Abakiriya basikana QR Code bagatanga komande, igikoni kigahita kibona imenyesha, kandi ubwishyu bugakorwa mu buryo bwikora. Kurikirana imibare y'ubucuruzi bwawe, tegura Promotions kandi wagure ubucuruzi bwawe nta mpungenge.
how_it_works.cta_subtitle: Kora konti yawe — bifata iminota 2 gusa!

why_switch.subtitle: Ubushobozi bukemura ibibazo izindi sisitemu zitita ku byo.

why_switch.ab_desc: Gerageza ibiciro, amagambo n'amafoto. Hitamo ibitanga umusaruro ushingiye ku makuru.

why_ai.cost_anomaly_desc: Menya mu buryo bwikora izamuka ry'ibiciro by'abatanga ibikoresho ukoresheje AI.

why_trust.title: Si POS isanzwe ifite amashusho meza. Ni Platform y'ubwenge ku rwego rw'ibigo.

faq.subtitle: Kwishyura, Amafaranga ya Serivisi n'Amabwiriza ya Platform

contact.heading: Ufite ikindi kibazo?
contact.body: Itsinda ryacu ryo kugufasha rihora ryiteguye kugufasha. Twandikire igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
contact.hours_value: Kuwa Mbere – Ku Cyumweru, 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM

0.q: Kuki hari amafaranga ya serivisi ku kwishyura hakoreshejwe Platform?
0.a: Amafaranga ya serivisi ya 5% afasha gutunganya ubwishyu, kurinda uburiganya, kwemeza ubwishyu bwihuse no gutuma ibikorwa byose bikora neza. Iyo wishyuye mu mafaranga (Cash), nta mafaranga ya serivisi acibwa.

1.a: Kwishyura mu mafaranga (Cash) ntibigira amafaranga ya serivisi. Amafaranga ya serivisi akoreshwa gusa ku kwishyura hakoreshejwe ikarita cyangwa Mobile Money.

2.q: Ni ayahe mafaranga make n'ayahe menshi ya serivisi?
2.a: Amafaranga make ya serivisi ni RWF 100, naho menshi ni RWF 3,500. N'iyo itumizwa ryaba rinini gute, amafaranga ya serivisi ntazigera arenza RWF 3,500.

3.q: Ese inama (Tips) zibarwa mu mafaranga ya serivisi?
3.a: Oya. Tips ntizibarwa mu mafaranga ya serivisi. Amafaranga abarwa gusa ku biryo n'ibinyobwa byatumijwe.

4.q: Ese TVA iba irimo mu mafaranga ya serivisi?
4.a: Yego. Amafaranga ya serivisi agaragazwa harimo TVA, bityo nta yandi mafaranga yihishe wongerwa igihe wishyura.

5.q: Ni ubuhe buryo bwo kwishyura bucibwa amafaranga ya serivisi?
5.a: Amafaranga ya serivisi akoreshwa ku kwishyura hakoreshejwe Visa, Mastercard na Mobile Money. Kwishyura mu mafaranga (Cash) cyangwa kohereza kuri banki ntibicibwa amafaranga ya serivisi.

6.a: Ku bicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi bicuruzwa binyuze kuri Marketplace, komisiyo ni 10% + TVA ku bacuruzi bashya, 7% + TVA ku basanzwe, na 5% + TVA ku bacuruzi bafite ibicuruzwa byinshi (barenga RWF 5M ku kwezi).

7.a: Yego. Kwishyura kose gutanga inyemezabuguzi ya EBM igaragaza ibisobanuro byose by'ubwishyu, harimo amafaranga ya serivisi (niba ahari), TVA n'umubare wishyuwe.

8.q: Nakora iki niba ntekereza ko naciwe amafaranga atari yo?
8.a: Hamagara itsinda ryacu ryo kugufasha ukoresheje support@imboni.resto cyangwa +250 788 917 126. Tuzasuzuma ikibazo cyawe kandi tugisubize mu masaha 24–48.

9.q: Ese amafaranga ya serivisi ashobora guhinduka?
9.a: Yego. Mu gihe amafaranga ya serivisi ahindutse, tuzabimenyesha nibura iminsi 30 mbere binyuze kuri email no kuri Platform.

refer.title_page: Porogaramu yo Gutumira Abandi — Imboni Serve
refer.meta_description: Sangiza inshuti zawe Imboni Serve. Iyo zimaze gukora komande yujuje ibisabwa, mwembi muhabwa 1,000 RWF. Nta mipaka, nta makuru y'ubwishyu asabwa.
refer.subtitle: Sangiza inshuti zawe Imboni Serve. Iyo zimaze gukora komande yujuje ibisabwa, mwembi muhabwa 1,000 RWF. Nta mipaka, nta makuru y'ubwishyu asabwa — uhembwa ako kanya!

steps.1_desc: Injiza nimero ya telefoni yawe kugira ngo ubone kode yawe yihariye yo gutumira abandi.
steps.2_desc: Inshuti yawe ikoreshe urubuga cyangwa kode yawe maze ikore komande.
steps.3_desc: Komande ya mbere igomba kuba nibura 5,000 RWF.

refer.requirements_desc: Inshuti yawe igomba kurangiza komande yayo ya mbere nibura ya 5,000 RWF. Ni ibyo gusa.
refer.error_generate_failed: Ntibyashobotse gukora kode yo gutumira abandi.
refer.share_code_desc: Sangiza iyi kode abandi bashobora gukoresha Imboni Serve.
refer.welcome_bonus_desc: Iyo inshuti yawe irangije komande yayo ya mbere, mwembi muhabwa 1,000 RWF.
refer.unlimited_desc: Nta mubare ntarengwa wo gutumira. Uko utumira benshi, ni ko ibihembo byawe byiyongera.
refer.fast_payout_desc: Ibihembo byawe biboneka nyuma y'iminsi 7 yo kugenzura. Ushobora kubyakira kuri Mobile Money cyangwa kubikoresha muri Imboni Serve.
refer.step1_desc: Ohereza urubuga rwawe rwo gutumira ukoresheje WhatsApp, SMS cyangwa imbuga nkoranyambaga.
refer.step2_desc: Inshuti yawe ikoreshe urubuga rwawe maze ikore komande yayo ya mbere nibura ya 5,000 RWF.
refer.step3_desc: 1,000 RWF zishyirwa kuri konti ya buri wese nyuma y'iminsi 7 yo kugenzura.
refer.redeem_dine_desc: Koresha amafaranga yawe wishyure muri resitora zikoresha Imboni Serve.
refer.redeem_cash_desc: Ohereza amafaranga kuri MTN MoMo cyangwa Airtel Money nyuma yo kwemeza konti yawe.
refer.redeem_cash_list_2: Konti igomba kuba imaze nibura iminsi 30.
refer.terms_validation: Ibihembo bitangwa nyuma y'iminsi 7 yo kugenzura komande.
refer.terms_min_order: Komande ya mbere igomba kuba nibura 5,000 RWF.
refer.terms_one_time: 1,000 RWF zitangwa rimwe kuri buri nshuti.
refer.terms_withdrawal: Kubikuza kuri Mobile Money bisaba nibura 10,000 RWF.
refer.affiliate_desc: Niba ushaka kuzanira Imboni Serve abakiriya b'ubucuruzi ukabona komisiyo ya 15% buri kwezi, ushobora kwinjira muri porogaramu y'abafatanyabikorwa.
